name: Agent Bits
description: Machine-readable utilities and datasets for AI agents.

capabilities.name: base64_decode
capabilities.description: Decode a Base64 string into UTF-8 text and report invalid payloads as errors when recovering embedded credentials, tokens, or transport-encoded content.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic Base64 decoding.
use_when: Decode this Base64 string to UTF-8 text
Recover plain text from a Base64-encoded payload
Check whether a Base64 string is valid and decode it
do_not_use_when: Encode plain text to Base64 (use base64_encode)
Decode percent-encoded URL components (use url_decode)
Decrypt ciphertext—Base64 decoding is not decryption

discovery_intents.title: Decode Base64 to text
discovery_intents.description: Decode a Base64 string into UTF-8 text, reporting invalid payloads as errors.

capabilities.name: base64_encode
capabilities.description: Convert a UTF-8 string into standard Base64 when you need a portable text encoding for credentials, binary-safe transport, or embedding data in JSON/HTTP fields.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic Base64 encoding of text.
use_when: Encode this UTF-8 string as Base64
Convert plain text into standard Base64 for transport
Produce a Base64 representation of a credential or payload string
do_not_use_when: Decode Base64 back to text (use base64_decode)
Percent-encode URL components (use url_encode)
Hash or encrypt data for security—Base64 is encoding only

discovery_intents.title: Encode text to Base64
discovery_intents.description: Encode a UTF-8 string into standard Base64.

capabilities.name: countries
capabilities.description: Versioned curated country metadata dataset used by country_lookup and countries_bulk.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs ISO country metadata as a dataset rather than invoking a single lookup.
use_when: Download the full countries reference dataset
Need every ISO country record in one request
do_not_use_when: Look up a single country by ISO code (use country_lookup, free)
limitations: Single-country lookup via country_lookup remains free.

payment.notes: No account. No API key. No signup. Agents can pay programmatically via x402.

capabilities.name: countries_bulk
capabilities.description: Download the complete versioned countries dataset as JSON for caching, offline use, or multi-country analysis when a single country_lookup call is not enough.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need the complete countries dataset for a specific version (for caching, offline use, or multi-country analysis) instead of looking up one country code at a time.
use_when: Download the full countries dataset as JSON
Cache the complete versioned countries snapshot for offline use
Analyze or filter many countries without repeated single-code lookups
do_not_use_when: Look up metadata for a single country by ISO code (use country_lookup instead)
Look up one currency or language code (use currency_lookup / language_lookup)
Fetch live geopolitical or exchange-rate feeds

version.description: Dataset version to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limitations: Paid capability. Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 / payment challenge.
Returns the curated Agent Bits countries dataset, not a live feed.

discovery_intents.title: Download countries dataset
discovery_intents.description: Retrieve the full versioned countries dataset as JSON for bulk or offline use.

payment.notes: No account. No API key. No signup. Agents can pay programmatically via x402.

capabilities.name: country_lookup
capabilities.description: Resolve an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example CA, US, JP) to official name, region, currency, calling code, languages, and related country metadata when you already have the two-letter code.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a country identified by an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example CA, US, JP), including common name, official name, region, currency, calling code, or languages.
use_when: What currency and calling code does country code JP use?
Get official name, region, and languages for ISO country CA
Look up standardized metadata for a two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code
do_not_use_when: Download the full countries dataset for offline or multi-country use (use countries_bulk)
Look up currency symbol or decimals by ISO 4217 code alone (use currency_lookup)
Search for a country when you only know its English name and not the ISO code

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example CA or JP

limitations: Accepts ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes only in v1.
Dataset is a curated subset/versioned snapshot, not a live geopolitical feed.

discovery_intents.title: Look up country from ISO code
discovery_intents.description: Resolve an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to name, currency, calling code, languages, and region metadata.

capabilities.name: currencies
capabilities.description: Curated currencies dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs the currencies reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service.
Not a live continuously updating feed.

capabilities.name: currency_lookup
capabilities.description: Resolve an ISO 4217 currency code such as USD, EUR, or JPY to its name, symbol, decimal places, and which countries use it when you need currency metadata rather than a live exchange rate.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a currency code such as USD, EUR, or JPY.
use_when: What is the symbol and number of decimal places for EUR?
Which countries use currency code JPY?
Get ISO 4217 name and metadata for USD
do_not_use_when: Convert amounts between currencies or fetch live FX rates
Find which currency a country uses when you only have a country code (use country_lookup)
Validate payment-card-like numbers (use luhn_validate)

discovery_intents.title: Look up currency from ISO 4217 code
discovery_intents.description: Resolve an ISO 4217 currency code to name, symbol, decimals, and related countries.

capabilities.name: http_status_lookup
capabilities.description: Explain what a numeric HTTP status code such as 404 or 429 means by returning its standard reason phrase and a short description for debugging or API responses.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need the meaning of an HTTP status code such as 404 or 429.
use_when: What does HTTP status 404 mean?
Get the standard name and description for status code 429
Explain an HTTP response code returned by an API
do_not_use_when: Decide whether a request succeeded without needing the status name
Look up MIME types or content-type headers (use mime_lookup)
Diagnose TLS, DNS, or network failures that are not HTTP status codes

discovery_intents.title: Explain an HTTP status code
discovery_intents.description: Resolve a numeric HTTP status code to its standard name and short description.

capabilities.name: isbn_validate
capabilities.description: Verify whether an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 passes checksum rules and return normalized digits when checking book identifiers before catalog or purchase flows.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to determine whether an ISBN is checksum-valid.
use_when: Is this ISBN valid?
Check the checksum for an ISBN-13 book identifier
Normalize and validate an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 string
do_not_use_when: Look up book title, author, or cover metadata from an ISBN
Validate UUIDs (use uuid_validate) or payment-card Luhn numbers (use luhn_validate)
Validate arbitrary barcode formats that are not ISBN-10/13

discovery_intents.title: Validate an ISBN checksum
discovery_intents.description: Validate ISBN-10/ISBN-13 identifiers using checksum rules and return normalized digits.

capabilities.name: json_validate
capabilities.description: Parse a string as JSON to confirm it is well-formed and return a normalized representation when possible before further processing or storage.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to verify that text is valid JSON before further processing.
use_when: Is this string valid JSON?
Parse and normalize a JSON payload before processing
Check whether agent or user-supplied text is well-formed JSON
do_not_use_when: Validate against a specific JSON Schema or OpenAPI model beyond well-formedness
Encode or decode Base64 (use base64_encode / base64_decode)
Validate UUID or ISBN identifier formats

discovery_intents.title: Validate a JSON string
discovery_intents.description: Parse and validate a JSON string, returning validity and a normalized form when possible.

capabilities.name: language_lookup
capabilities.description: Resolve an ISO 639-1 language code such as en, fr, or ja to its English name and native name when you need language metadata from a two-letter code.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a language code such as en, fr, or ja.
use_when: What language does ISO 639-1 code ja refer to?
Get the native name for language code fr
Resolve a two-letter language code to its English and native names
do_not_use_when: Translate text between languages
Detect the language of arbitrary free-form text
Look up country languages from a country code (use country_lookup)

discovery_intents.title: Look up language from ISO 639-1 code
discovery_intents.description: Resolve an ISO 639-1 language code to English and native language names.

capabilities.name: languages
capabilities.description: Curated languages dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs the languages reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service.
Not a live continuously updating feed.

capabilities.name: luhn_validate
capabilities.description: Run the Luhn checksum on a numeric string such as a payment-card-like identifier to verify the check digit before accepting or storing the value.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to verify a number with a Luhn check digit.
use_when: Does this number pass a Luhn check?
Validate a payment-card-like identifier checksum
Verify a numeric ID that uses a Luhn check digit
do_not_use_when: Charge a card, tokenize payments, or call a payment processor
Validate ISBNs (use isbn_validate) or UUIDs (use uuid_validate)
Look up currency metadata (use currency_lookup)

value.description: Numeric string to validate with Luhn

discovery_intents.title: Validate a Luhn checksum
discovery_intents.description: Verify a numeric string using the Luhn check-digit algorithm.

capabilities.name: mime_lookup
capabilities.description: Map a file extension such as webp or png, or a MIME type string, to curated Content-Type metadata when setting headers, validating uploads, or choosing a media type.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need the MIME type for a file extension such as webp, or metadata for a MIME type string.
use_when: What MIME type should I use for a .webp file?
Look up metadata for Content-Type application/json
Resolve a file extension to the correct MIME type for an upload or response header
do_not_use_when: Sniff or detect MIME type from raw file bytes
Encode or decode Base64 file payloads (use base64_encode / base64_decode)
Look up DNS top-level domain metadata (use tld_lookup)

discovery_intents.title: Resolve MIME type from extension
discovery_intents.description: Map a file extension or MIME type string to curated MIME metadata.

capabilities.name: mime-types
capabilities.description: Curated mime-types dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs the mime-types reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service.
Not a live continuously updating feed.

capabilities.name: timestamp_convert
capabilities.description: Convert Unix epoch seconds or milliseconds to ISO-8601, or an ISO-8601 datetime to Unix epoch values, when bridging APIs that disagree on time formats.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic conversion between Unix timestamps and ISO-8601 datetimes.
use_when: Convert this Unix timestamp to ISO-8601
Turn an ISO-8601 datetime into epoch milliseconds
Bridge APIs that mix Unix seconds and ISO-8601 strings
do_not_use_when: Convert a datetime between IANA timezones while preserving the instant (use timezone_convert)
Convert length, mass, or temperature units (use unit_convert)
Interpret relative phrases like 'next Tuesday' or 'in 3 hours'

discovery_intents.title: Convert Unix and ISO timestamps
discovery_intents.description: Convert between Unix epoch seconds/milliseconds and ISO-8601 datetime strings.

capabilities.name: timezone_convert
capabilities.description: Convert an ISO-8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another while preserving the same instant, including daylight-saving-aware wall times such as Toronto to Tokyo.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to convert a datetime between IANA timezones, including daylight-saving-time-aware conversions.
use_when: What time is 3pm Toronto in Tokyo?
Convert an ISO-8601 datetime from America/New_York to Europe/London
Show the same instant in another IANA timezone with DST-aware offsets
do_not_use_when: Only convert between Unix epoch and ISO-8601 without changing timezone (use timestamp_convert)
Convert length, mass, or temperature units (use unit_convert)
Guess a city timezone from a postal address without an IANA zone id

datetime.description: ISO-8601 datetime, with or without offset

from_timezone.description: IANA timezone for interpreting naive datetimes

limitations: Relies on the runtime IANA timezone database via Intl.

discovery_intents.title: Convert datetime between timezones
discovery_intents.description: Convert an ISO-8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another, preserving the instant.

capabilities.name: timezones
capabilities.description: Curated timezones dataset (v1, 17 records) used by related lookup tools.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs the timezones reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service.
Not a live continuously updating feed.

capabilities.name: tld_lookup
capabilities.description: Identify what a DNS top-level domain such as com, io, or ai is classified as and commonly used for when classifying domains or answering TLD questions.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to understand what a TLD is classified as or commonly used for.
use_when: What kind of TLD is .io?
Is .ai a country-code or generic top-level domain?
Get curated metadata for DNS TLD com
do_not_use_when: Check whether a full domain name is registered or available
Resolve DNS records or WHOIS ownership
Look up MIME types for file extensions (use mime_lookup)

discovery_intents.title: Look up TLD metadata
discovery_intents.description: Resolve a DNS top-level domain to curated classification and usage metadata.

capabilities.name: unit_convert
capabilities.description: Convert a numeric value between supported length, mass, or temperature units—for example miles to kilometers or Celsius to Fahrenheit—when you need a deterministic unit conversion.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic unit conversion such as miles to kilometers or Celsius to Fahrenheit.
use_when: Convert 10 miles to kilometers
What is 25°C in Fahrenheit?
Convert a mass value between kilograms and pounds
do_not_use_when: Convert currencies or fetch exchange rates (use currency_lookup for metadata only)
Convert timestamps or timezones (use timestamp_convert / timezone_convert)
Convert unsupported unit categories outside length, mass, and temperature
limitations: Supports a curated set of length, mass, and temperature units in v1.

discovery_intents.title: Convert length, mass, or temperature
discovery_intents.description: Convert numeric values between supported units for length, mass, and temperature.

capabilities.name: url_decode
capabilities.description: Decode a percent-encoded URL component into plain text when reading query parameters, path segments, or form values that contain escaped characters.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic URL component decoding.
use_when: Decode this percent-encoded URL component
Convert %20-style escapes back to plain text
Recover the original string from an encoded query parameter
do_not_use_when: Percent-encode text for a URL (use url_encode)
Decode Base64 payloads (use base64_decode)
Parse HTML entities that are not URL percent-encoding

discovery_intents.title: Decode a percent-encoded URL component
discovery_intents.description: Decode a percent-encoded URL component into plain text.

capabilities.name: url_encode
capabilities.description: Apply encodeURIComponent-style percent-encoding so query parameters, path segments, or form values are safe to place in a URL.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need deterministic URL component encoding.
use_when: Percent-encode this string for a query parameter
Make a path segment URL-safe with encodeURIComponent-style encoding
Encode special characters before inserting text into a URL
do_not_use_when: Decode a percent-encoded string (use url_decode)
Encode binary data as Base64 (use base64_encode)
Build or rewrite a full absolute URL structure beyond component encoding

discovery_intents.title: Percent-encode a URL component
discovery_intents.description: Apply encodeURIComponent-style percent-encoding to a string.

capabilities.name: uuid_validate
capabilities.description: Check whether a string is a well-formed UUID and, when recognizable, report its version and variant so you can accept or reject identifier inputs confidently.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need to check if a value is a valid UUID, including common version 4 identifiers.
use_when: Is this string a valid UUID?
What version and variant is this UUID?
Validate a UUID before using it as a primary key or request id
do_not_use_when: Generate a new UUID
Validate ISBNs or other non-UUID identifiers (use isbn_validate)
Validate JSON structure (use json_validate)

discovery_intents.title: Validate a UUID string
discovery_intents.description: Check whether a string is a UUID and report version/variant metadata when possible.
